title: Fontana Mix 2026: A chance-operations score generator for human-AI co-creative practice
description: A browser-based open-score instrument for human-AI co-creative practice, after John Cage's Fontana Mix (1958). Two eight-sided dice cast an I Ching hexagram. The throw, together with the sheets switched on, deterministically fixes a composite score: selections from three vocabulary sheets (Language, Image, Process), a compositional diagram governing placement, rotation and scale, and generated mark fields. A prompt directive for generative image synthesis is then drawn at random from the selected terms and recorded. Built as the practice-based core of a cognitive-autoethnographic study of human-AI co-creation in neural painting, the instrument sets chance operations against the convergent tendencies of generative inference, a condition the project calls restricted indeterminacy. Because each cast and journal entry is timestamped, the record preserves score directives alongside the performer's responses, so that the two can be compared. The deposit includes the instrument as a single self-contained HTML file, the exported performance log of the documented test performance, an errata file, a record of design decisions, and a test that re-enters every logged cast and compares the result with the log.
